'''Carl Mike Hardy Hoth Dark Side Training Deck''' is a [[Dark]] training list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]]. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] built it from Common and Uncommon cards for teaching.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' by January 2001 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth Dark Side

== Introduction ==

The published list has 30 cards.
